purpose: Offline differential of the C07 usage/billing view, refresh, export and interrupted-recovery behaviour of the unchanged pinned pi-cursor-sdk usage modules, run against the real Pi 1.3.0 SessionManager with an injected clock/randomness/IDs and a fake @cursor/sdk usage endpoint. No Cursor network calls.

injection.clock: Date is fixed at 2026-10-22T00:00:00.123Z via inject.cjs.
injection.randomness: node:crypto randomUUID/randomBytes/randomInt are replaced by monotonic deterministic values via a CJS preload, so entry ids, turn ids and record ids replay.
injection.sessions: Session files are prefixed with a fixed header id; interrupted-recovery forks reuse that id.
injection.fakeSdk: The bare @cursor/sdk specifier is redirected to tests/c-usage/sdk.mjs; Agent.getUsage answers from RPI_CURSOR_USAGE_SDK_RESPONSE.
injection.paths: The per-run temporary root is replaced by <root> in every captured string and journal byte.

Storage ceiling: 16MiB per origin session. At the ceiling or after an incomplete trailing frame, new sends fail before spend. A torn tail is retained unchanged; view/export preserve validated prior frames and mark accounting incomplete. Malformed complete frames remain fail-closed.
Recovery: export readable facts and retain the original journal/session unchanged. Use Pi's native fork to preserve the conversation under a new session origin, or start a new native session. Never delete, truncate, or rewrite journals or native sessions to continue the old origin.
Other-branch facts have valid native claims elsewhere in this session; unclaimed facts have no surviving claim here and are not branch usage. Inherited records without a claim in this session retain unknown ownership; no sibling sessions are scanned. Fileless sessions are ephemeral.

rust: tests/c_usage_reference.rs replays every recorded journal frame sequence and recovery prefix through the native JournalPort and compares complete bytes and outcomes.
notTested: Live Cursor billing, real cloud agents and the raw REST usage fallback (/v1/agents/{id}/usage) are not exercised.
Interactive/TUI/RPC rendering is not exercised; only the non-UI notification and export paths are recorded.
The native rpi worker's own copy of the usage ledger is exercised only at the journal-port boundary by the Rust replay, not end-to-end through the DLL.
C09 lifecycle stop-admission/cancel/close/flush/reap is covered separately by lifecycle-reference.mjs and the Rust worker tests.
